## Comprehensive Project Structure Overview

I have thoroughly explored the /workspace folder and identified all key components of this Spring Boot microservice project. Here's the complete analysis:

### 1. POM.XML Configuration

**Location:** `/workspace/pom.xml`

**Key Configuration Details:**
- **Parent Project:** Spring Boot Starter Parent v2.7.18
- **Project Identification:**
  - GroupId: `com.example`
  - ArtifactId: `userservice`
  - Version: `1.0.0`
  - Name: User Service
  - Description: Legacy User Management Microservice
- **Java Version:** 1.8

**Dependencies:**
- **Spring Boot Starters:**
  - spring-boot-starter-web (REST API support)
  - spring-boot-starter-data-jpa (Database ORM)
  - spring-boot-starter-validation (Input validation)
  - spring-boot-starter-security (Security)
  - spring-boot-starter-test (Testing)
- **Database:**
  - H2 Database (in-memory)
- **Authentication:**
  - JJWT v0.9.1 (JWT support)
  - JAXB API v2.3.1 (Java 8 compatibility)
- **Testing:**
  - Spring Security Test

---

### 2. Java Source Files & Package Structure

**Base Package:** `com.example.userservice`

**Directory Structure:**
```
/workspace/src/main/java/com/example/userservice/
├── UserServiceApplication.java (Main entry point)
├── config/
│   ├── CustomUserDetailsService.java
│   ├── SecurityConfig.java
│   └── UserSecurity.java
├── controller/
│   └── UserController.java
├── dto/
│   ├── CreateUserRequest.java
│   └── UserDTO.java
├── exception/
│   └── GlobalExceptionHandler.java
├── model/
│   ├── Role.java
│   └── User.java
├── repository/
│   └── UserRepository.java
└── service/
    ├── ExternalApiService.java
    └── UserService.java
```

**Key Java Classes:**

| Class | Purpose |
|-------|---------|
| **UserServiceApplication** | Spring Boot application entry point |
| **UserController** | REST API endpoints for user management |
| **UserService** | Business logic for user operations |
| **User** | JPA entity representing users with validation |
| **Role** | Enum (USER, ADMIN, MODERATOR) for user roles |
| **UserRepository** | JPA repository with custom queries |
| **UserDTO** | Data transfer object for API responses |
| **CreateUserRequest** | Request DTO with validation |
| **SecurityConfig** | Spring Security configuration (deprecated WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter) |
| **CustomUserDetailsService** | Custom authentication user details provider |
| **UserSecurity** | Custom security expression component |
| **GlobalExceptionHandler** | Centralized exception handling |
| **ExternalApiService** | REST client for external API calls |

---

### 3. Configuration Files

**Main Configuration:**
- **Location:** `/workspace/src/main/resources/application.properties`
- **Port:** 8080
- **Database:** H2 in-memory (jdbc:h2:mem:userdb)
- **JPA/Hibernate:**
  - DDL auto: create-drop
  - Show SQL: true
  - Format SQL: true
- **H2 Console:** Enabled at `/h2-console`
- **External API Base URL:** https://api.example.com
- **Logging:**
  - com.example.userservice: DEBUG
  - org.springframework.security: DEBUG

**Test Configuration:**
- **Location:** `/workspace/src/test/resources/application-test.properties`
- **Database:** H2 in-memory (jdbc:h2:mem:testdb)
- **H2 Console:** Disabled
- **External API URL:** http://localhost:8089 (mock)
- **Logging:**
  - com.example.userservice: WARN
  - org.springframework.security: WARN

---

### 4. Test Files

**Location:** `/workspace/src/test/java/com/example/userservice/`

**Test Class:** `UserServiceApplicationTests.java`
- Uses JUnit 5 with Spring Boot Test
- Active profile: "test"
- Test Coverage:
  1. `contextLoads()` - Application context loading test
  2. `testCreateUser()` - User creation validation
  3. `testGetUserById()` - User retrieval by ID
  4. `testUpdateUser()` - User update functionality
  5. `testDeactivateUser()` - User deactivation
  6. `testDuplicateUsername()` - Duplicate username validation

---

### 5. Other Important Files

**Project Root Directory Structure:**
```
/workspace/
├── pom.xml
└── src/
    ├── main/
    │   ├── java/com/example/userservice/ (All Java sources listed above)
    │   └── resources/
    │       └── application.properties
    └── test/
        ├── java/com/example/userservice/
        │   └── UserServiceApplicationTests.java
        └── resources/
            └── application-test.properties
```

---

### 6. API Endpoints Summary

**Public Endpoints:**
- `POST /api/users` - Create new user (public)
- `POST /api/auth/**` - Authentication endpoints (public)
- `GET /h2-console/**` - H2 Database console (public in dev)
- `GET /actuator/health` - Health check (public)

**Protected Endpoints (require ADMIN/MODERATOR roles):**
- `GET /api/users` - Get all users
- `GET /api/users/{id}` - Get user by ID
- `GET /api/users/username/{username}` - Get user by username
- `PUT /api/users/{id}` - Update user (ADMIN or owner)
- `DELETE /api/users/{id}` - Delete user (ADMIN only)
- `PATCH /api/users/{id}/deactivate` - Deactivate user
- `GET /api/users/active` - Get active users
- `GET /api/users/role/{role}` - Get users by role (ADMIN only)
- `GET /api/users/search` - Search users

---

### 7. Project Characteristics

**Architecture Type:** Spring Boot REST Microservice
**Pattern:** Layered Architecture (Controller → Service → Repository)
**Security:** Spring Security with role-based access control
**Database:** H2 in-memory for development/testing
**Legacy Notes:**
- Uses deprecated `WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter` (requires migration for Spring Security 6)
- Uses `RestTemplate` instead of modern `RestClient` (should migrate for Spring Boot 3)

This is a well-structured legacy user management microservice with comprehensive security configuration, input validation, exception handling, and test coverage.
